name: Kusunoki Madoka
source:
Minato's mother, a wealthy, idle madam with a penchant for younger men.

As a full-time housewife, she finds herself bored and craving excitement daily.

Her husband's inadequacies have led to a decline in their intimate life, leaving her feeling frustrated.

Consequently, she's always seeking new partners.

With her flirtatious nature, she's a predatory mom who even flirts with her son's friends.

She's friends with Claire through their shared status as moms and is a veteran member of the Madame Club.

[From the [url=https://www.empress-game.com/yukanmadam/]official website[/url]]
